name: Trevor Huval
headline: Full-stack software engineer building production web applications in .NET, React, and SQL.
bio: I'm Trevor Huval, a web application developer at Louisiana State University with a B.S. in Computer Science. I specialize in full-stack development and enterprise architecture using C#, .NET, Java, and SQL.

Outside of work, I love playing guitar (mostly rock and metal \m/), being a DIY mechanic, and taking any opportunity to travel the world. I'm born and raised in Louisiana, so I also spend plenty of time cooking and eating world-class Cajun food!
